subject: STraTA kickoff - few-shot bootstrapping as a product recipe
body:
Team,

Kicking off STraTA productization. Customer problem: teams come to us with 30-100 labeled examples and expect a working classifier. STraTA is our best answer - self-training combined with task augmentation, where a T5-based generator produces synthetic NLI data to build a strong base model before the self-training loop runs. Bonus: the repo notes it works as an automatic data-labeling tool, which is a second product surface on its own.

Also relevant: the current open-source implementation typically beats the numbers reported in the paper, so our baseline story is stronger than the citation.

Milestones: repro on 3 few-shot benchmarks by March 6; recipe hardening (configs, failure modes, practical recommendations) by April 10; packaged internal release + adoption review April 30.

Alina, staffing and compute this week please. This should be a lean one.

Anders
